# Speakrs audio fixture

`speakrs-two-speaker-16k.wav` is generated locally by
`generate_speakrs_fixture.ps1` from original test dialogue written for
AvaNevis. The script uses the Microsoft Hazel and Zira Desktop voices bundled
with Windows; it does not contain or sample third-party recordings.

The generated file is mono, 16 kHz, 16-bit PCM and is used only to verify the
native Speakrs CLI contract and local model inference.
